messages.速度の高さで先に動き、最大値の高い1コインスキルで敵の危険なスキルをマッチで止め: A guard tank that acts early through high Speed and stops dangerous enemy skills with high-maximum-Power single-Coin clashes. S3's Blunt Fragility also helps allies' Blunt attacks deal damage.
messages.速度と1コインスキル: 速度範囲値は5~6から、同期化で最大5~8まで伸びる。全: **Speed and 1-Coin skills**: Her Speed range starts at 5–6 and extends up to 5–8 through Uptie. All of her attack skills have 1 Coin, so higher SP makes it easier to roll her maximum, while low SP makes her crumble.
messages.S3「防御」: マッチ威力8~20の1コイン打撃スキル。的中時に振動爆発し、打撃: **S3 — Shield Bash**: A 1-Coin Blunt skill with Clash Power 8–20. Triggers Tremor Burst on hit and inflicts 1 Blunt Fragility.
messages.S2「スライディング」: マッチ勝利時に守備威力減少1/3を付与する。的中時に振: **S2 — Slide**: Inflicts 1/3 Defense Power Down on Clash Win. Inflicts 3 Tremor on hit.
messages.振動: S2で振動3を入れてからS3を当てれば、単独でも振動爆発を狙える。S1「: **Tremor**: Landing S3 after applying 3 Tremor with S2 lets her aim for Tremor Burst on her own. S1 Loggerhead only increases Tremor Count by 1, so to make real use of Tremor, pair her with allies who inflict it.
messages.パッシブ: バトルパッシブ「足掻く」(憤怒×3・保有)は自分の体力が25%未満で: **Passives**: The combat passive Last-ditch Struggle (3 Wrath Owned) gives +1 Clash Power below 25% of her HP. The support passive Determination to Survive (6 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives +1 Clash Power while the 1 ally with the lowest HP is below 50%.
messages.速度で先に行動できるので、敵の強いスキルや味方が不利なマッチを引き受け、S3の高: Her Speed lets her act first, so she takes on the enemy's strong skills and Clashes unfavorable for allies, stopping them with S3's high maximum. Early on, when SP is low, her single Coin's low rolls make her lose easily, so start up carefully. The Blunt Fragility from S3 pays off when paired with allies who hit with Blunt. Treat Tremor as a bonus, making use of S3's Tremor Burst when S2 lands before S3 or when allies inflict Tremor.
